cards.card_text: A fugitive and a wanderer A ruler over the land A servant to his father
cards.verse_text: You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”
cards.snippet: You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

cards.card_text: Israel strikes them down until no survivor or fugitive remains.
cards.verse_text: So Israel struck them down until no survivor or fugitive remained.
cards.snippet: So Israel struck them down until no survivor or fugitive remained.

cards.card_text: You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim You Gileadites are cowards in battle You Gileadites have no real leader
cards.verse_text: And the men of Gilead struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, “You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim, living in the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.”
cards.snippet: …Gilead struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, “You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim, living in the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.”

cards.card_text: Moab's fugitives flee as far as Zoar and Eglath-shelishiyah.
cards.verse_text: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath-shelishiyah.
cards.snippet: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath-shelishiyah.

cards.card_text: What will come upon the fugitives of Moab and the remnant of the land?
cards.verse_text: The waters of Dimon are full of blood, but I will bring more upon Dimon—a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon the remnant of the land.
cards.snippet: …of blood, but I will bring more upon Dimon—a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon the remnant of the land.

cards.verse_text: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
cards.snippet: …your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.

cards.card_text: Now the LORD calls out: "Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations." Not keep away, friend.
cards.verse_text: Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations.
cards.snippet: Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations.

cards.card_text: Only a few fugitives Only the priests Only the women and children
cards.verse_text: so that none of the remnant of Judah who have gone to reside in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, where they long to return and live; for none will return except a few fugitives.”
cards.snippet: …long to return and live; for none will return except a few fugitives.”

cards.card_text: When the Ammonites are each driven headlong, the LORD says someone will regather the fugitives.
cards.verse_text: You will each be driven headlong, with no one to regather the fugitives.
cards.snippet: You will each be driven headlong, with no one to regather the fugitives.

cards.card_text: Fugitives and refugees are getting out of Babylon, and they're showing up in Zion.
cards.verse_text: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, declaring in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance for His temple.
cards.snippet: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, declaring in Zion the vengeance…

cards.card_text: The LORD also says Edom should not stand at the crossroads to cut off Judah's fugitives.
cards.verse_text: Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress.
cards.snippet: Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress.
